title: Hegseth denies report he's eyeing 2028 presidential bid
text:
Secretary of War Pete Hegseth on Friday denied a report that he is considering a presidential bid in 2028, as speculation builds around which Republicans will battle to succeed President Donald Trump.

“100% false. We told NBC that, but they just lie w/ anonymous ‘sources,’” Hegseth said on social media.
